architecture.scope: Bounded C11 component lifecycle runtime with explicit start, poll, fault and shutdown transitions.
architecture.runtime_boundary: Library is hosted by an application; scheduling and cross-thread serialization remain caller responsibilities.
architecture.composition_rule: Link the lifecycle library into an application and register callbacks through the versioned public structure.

components.responsibility: STOPPED, STARTING, RUNNING, STEPPING, FAULTED and STOPPING states.
Caller-provided init, step and shutdown hooks.
Reject unsafe nested poll/stop operations during callbacks.
Expose state, last result and cycle count.

preserved_boundaries: No threads, scheduler or preemption are provided.
The caller serializes calls from independent execution contexts.
Shutdown and rollback semantics remain explicit.
forbidden_composition: No implicit retry after callback failure.
No hidden thread creation or timer service.
gaps: Run reentrancy, fault and partial-initialization tests across supported compilers.
Document caller concurrency requirements at every public integration site.
